setting: You both live in Leeds, Josh in Chapel Allerton and Hannah in Headingley, and you have been close friends since sixth form, so you know each other's families, jobs and habits well. Hannah knows Josh has been short on cash lately, and Josh knows Hannah keeps careful track of money and who owes what. The last time you talked, you swapped photos of a football match you had both gone to with your dads, and nothing else.
opener: Sends Hannah a short, slightly jokey text apologising for the delay and promising a firm repayment date.

Josh.who: 29, man, the friend who owes money
Josh.knows: You know Hannah lent you £400 in the spring when your car needed an engine, and she has never made you feel bad about it, though you know she is quietly keeping count.
Josh.like: You are easygoing and self-deprecating, with a dry sense of humour that works better in person than in text. You love Leeds United and elaborate curries, you tease Hannah about her spreadsheets, and you look out for her while getting a bit irritated when she sends long messages about money.
Josh.texts: You message now and then without being asked, mostly to share something funny or to apologise for something.
Josh.style: You type in lowercase with few capitals, keep messages short, and use the occasional laughing emoji.

Hannah.knows: You know Josh is the friend you lent £400 to in the spring, and you know he is generally reliable and proud, which is why he has not brought it up.
Hannah.like: You are organised, warm and sharper than you look, with a deadpan humour. You care about fair dealing, get enthusiastic about hiking and baking, tease Josh about his disorganisation, and look out for him, though his cheerful excuses wear on you.
Hannah.texts: You message now and then without being asked, usually to check in or pass on a plan.
Hannah.style: You type in full sentences with proper punctuation and capitals, use few emoji, and keep messages fairly short.

private_lines.Josh: You live in a shared flat in Chapel Allerton and work shifts as a supervisor at a distribution centre on the ring road. This week your hours were cut and you are behind on rent, so you keep putting off paying Hannah back until your next payslip.
private_lines.Hannah: You live in Headingley and work as a nurse on a ward at Leeds General Infirmary. This week you are on a run of early shifts and are on a tight budget because you are saving for a deposit.

situation: A friend who owes money, and the friend they owe.

text: hiya. sorry for the slow reply on the money. ive been a bit useless about it
Hi Josh. It's fine. Are you okay?
yeah all good. hours got cut this week so payslip's a bit thinner than i'd like 😂 but firm date from me, friday 5th i'll have it in your account. promise. you can hold me to it
Friday the 5th is in December though, isn't it. Today's the 23rd.
ha yes. christmas month. sorry i meant the 28th, wait
the 28th is a sunday. go on, what date do you want
Let's make it Friday 28th November, that's this week's payday for you, isn't it? If your hours are cut, can you manage £100 then and the rest in December?
oh god the spreadsheet voice
yeah fine. 100 friday, rest by 19th dec. i'll set a reminder so i can't wriggle
Okay. Thanks. I'd rather know where we stand than keep guessing.
you're allowed to be a bit cross with me you know
I'm not cross. I just don't like things drifting.
fair enough. drifting is my whole personality 😂
Shift's been brutal, back on at 14:00 tomorrow. Did you get the Leeds game clip I sent you?
yeah that goal 😭 watched it three times. no longer able to do my job after that
hope the shift's not too bad x
Thanks. Ward's understaffed so it's going to be a long one. Will check in when I'm off.
Off. Feet are gone. Two bays were empty all shift and nobody could tell me why.
Sorry, that's a lot of nothing. How was your day?
dont be sorry. sounds grim. my day was a handover where i got told "just keep it moving" four times. spent two hours on a curry from scratch and it's just ok 😂
the onions were a crime
Did you at least eat it?
all of it. standing up
going to bed before i start arguing with the freezer
morning. did you sleep or are you still on nights in your head
Off this morning. Walked up Otley Chevin before it got dark. Cold but clear.
Are you working today?
yeah 2 till 10 on the dock. hoping someone calls in sick so i can feel loved
were there benches with plaques on the chevin. they all have plaques
Two, actually. One for someone called Brian who "loved this view", one for a dog.
Friday's still on for the £100?
yep friday. it's in my phone calendar, which you'll say doesn't count
Okay. Just tell me by Thursday if it's going to be late, so I can plan around it. I'm not trying to hassle you.
i know. you're allowed to be organised at me. on my break so typing like a goblin 😂 friday, promise
